brief:
An Israeli drone struck a residential apartment in the al-Nasr neighbourhood west of Gaza City, according to Al Jazeera citing medical sources at al-Shifa Hospital. Children were among those wounded in the strike.

The al-Nasr area is located in a densely populated section of Gaza City. No further details about the number of casualties or the extent of injuries were provided.
dek: Israel targets apartment west of Gaza City, children amongst wounded An Israeli drone has targeted a residential apartment in al-Nasr neighbourhood, west of Gaza City, according to Al Jazeera citing medical sources at al-Shifa Hospital.
title: Israeli drone strikes Gaza apartment, wounds children
